text:
zoe-sales: Quick presales ask from SignalTel POC: EU-only processing, vendor control-plane must remain in EU, BYOK via customer HSM, and a notarized subproc snapshot. AE needs a concise decision matrix + cost delta. Who can take?

omar-ops: I can scope ops. Clarify: tenant pinning sufficient for POC?

zoe-sales: Tenant pinning ok for POC but control-plane telemetry must not leave EU.

linda-legal: If control-plane must be EU-hosted, standard hosted won't comply unless we spin a Private control plane in EU. I'll pull subproc export + SOC2 dates and prep a DPA addendum. Need customer legal contact.

tom-pricing: Ill put together ballpark costs. Need QPS, tokens, model, POC duration.

hugo-ml: Model rec: 7B-quant for cost/latency tradeoff; 13B only if customer wants higher capability. Will add perf notes.

omar-ops: Ops options to present: HOSTED+GEO_PIN (fast, control-plane multi-region), DEDICATED EU POOL (reserved GPUs, mid lead time), PRIVATE EU CONTROL PLANE (full residency, longer lead time). Key ops caveat: hosted+BYOK requires outbound mTLS to customer HSM endpoints; if firewall blocks, Private/VPC connector needed.

ops-bot: Presales template:
```
routing: "tenant_pin: eu-west-1"
control_plane: "eu_only: true|false"
kms: "BYOK-HSM: external, mTLS, cert_exchange"
fallback: "fallback_model: smaller-quant"
network: "ip_allowlist, peering, nat, egress_routes"
```

linda-legal: For BYOK-HSM we need keyflow diagram and confirmation customer HSM accepts mTLS from our nodes. Private simplifies attestation. I'll prepare notarized subproc bundle and DPA draft.

tom-pricing: POC inputs (AE): baseline 6 qps, spikes 30 qps, avg 140 tokens, 30d POC, 7B-quant. Ballpark EUR: HOSTED+PIN ~2.5k/mo + network setup ~3k; DEDICATED ~8k/mo + onboarding ~2k; PRIVATE ~16-20k/mo + SOW ~6-8k, lead 3-6w. BYOK integration SOW ~4-7k.

hugo-ml: Perf note: 7B-quant should hit median token latency ~150-250ms at this footprint; 13B would increase infra and cost.

zoe-sales: Action items: @tom one-pager decision matrix, @omar ops checklist + network runbook, @linda subproc export + DPA, @hugo perf appendix. I'll schedule a 20m handoff with AE tomorrow 11:00 CET. Thanks all :thumbsup:
